title: Senior Engineer - AI
jobDescription: JOB SUMMARY – The Senior Engineer – AI is responsible for end-to-end AI projects from problem definition to model to deployment and monitoring. The primary focus of this role is to combine expertise in machine learning, data engineering, and system architecture to deliver complex AI solutions. This position requires a deep understanding of AI principles, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – 3+ years of experience in AI/ML development, with a proven track record of production-level deployments. Expert in Python and familiar with core ML/DL frameworks (e.g., Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Hugging Face Transformers) Design and implement integrations using Model Context Protocol to connect AI models with external tools, APIs, and data sources. Strong experience developing AI-driven workflows using eknowledge platforms, and AI agent frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot, Glean, and Google Agentspace Solid understanding of ML theory, statistics, linear algebra, optimization, and deep learning architectures. Experience with cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps tools (MLflow, DVC, Airflow). Familiarity with tools for model explainability (SHAP, LIME), monitoring, and continuous retraining. Possesses and applies simple to moderate knowledge of particular product or platform to the completion of assignments Ability to learn, understand and adopt new software platforms and processes 3+ years experience using Jira, Bitbucket and Confluence agile toolsets or similar High proficiency in Microsoft Office suite products Good communication skills and ability to communicate at some levels of the organization (technical and business) 3+ years experience with IT ticketing software (Quality Center, Service Now, JIRA) 3+ years experience using Jira, Bitbucket and Confluence agile toolsets or similar 3+ years experience working with small, geographically distributed teams 3+ years experience working both independently and in a team oriented, collaborative environment 3+ years experience in agile/waterfall software delivery methodologies Ability to be flexible while delivering assignments with understanding that deliverables may change based on business needs EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS – Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in computer science, engineering or related field or equivalent work experience Principal Duties and Responsibilities – Problem & solution design Work with stakeholders to frame business problems as AI/ML use cases Define success metrics, constraints, and data requirements Data engineering & preparation Ingest, clean, and transform data from multiple sources Build and maintain feature pipelines / datasets for training and inference Model development Select appropriate algorithms (ML, deep learning, NLP, recommendation, etc.) Train, tune, and validate models using best practices (cross‑validation, baselines, ablation, etc.) Evaluation & experimentation Design experiments (A/B tests, offline metrics) to compare models and approaches Analyze results and iterate quickly to improve performance and robustness MLOps & deployment Package and deploy models to production (APIs, batch jobs, streaming) Implement CI/CD for ML, versioning of data/models, and reproducible training Monitoring & maintenance Set up monitoring for drift, performance, latency, cost, and failures Retrain, recalibrate, or roll back models as data and business conditions change Keeps abreast of improvements in software techniques and develop some improvements on own Ability to be flexible while delivering assignments with understanding that deliverables may change based on business needs ADDITIONAL CHARACTERISTICS – Independently performs assignments to achieve stated objective. Determines and develops approach to solutions Receives technical guidance only on unusual or complex problems or issues May be responsible for entire projects having moderate to complex scope/impact or portions of projects having considerable scope/impact Uses judgment and discretion to determine work priorities, receiving little instruction from others Committed to diversity and inclusion At Manhattan, it’s about more than just the work. From cultural celebrations to interest groups to volunteer opportunities, your true self is always welcome here. Our team members’ backgrounds, experiences and perspectives add to us as a whole and make us unique. We are proudly an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a veteran. In the United States, Manhattan Associates participates in the Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify) operated by the Department of Homeland Security in partnership with the Social Security Administration. Participation in the E-Verify Program allows Manhattan to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees after the Employment Eligibility Verification Form (Form I-9) has been completed. At Manhattan Associates our supply chain and omnichannel technology positively affect how people work, shop and live – every single day. Though we all take different paths to get here, everyone shares one belief: We’re good people doing great things.

title: Senior Engineer - SharePoint Administration
jobDescription:
We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place. Role Summary We are looking for a Senior /Lead Share Point Administrator to own and enhance our Share Point and Microsoft 365 collaboration platforms. You will lead administration, governance, migrations, and automation to enable secure, scalable, and user‑friendly collaboration across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities Share Point & M365 Ownership Administer and govern Share Point Online (and support Share Point 2016/2019 as needed) – sites, permissions, security, taxonomy, storage, and standards/SOPs. Enable and support Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (Share Point Online, One Drive, Stream, Viva, Microsoft Search) and integrations with Power Apps / Power Automate. Migrations, Automation & Operations Lead migrations from Share Point On‑Prem and shared drives/file shares to Share Point Online / One Drive using Sharegate, including assessment, execution, monitoring, and post‑migration validation. Provide L2/L3 support via ITSM tools (e.g., Service Now, Jira); troubleshoot incidents, perform root‑cause analysis, and close tickets within SLAs. Use Power Shell to automate administration, standardize configurations, and improve performance and reliability across environments. Must‑Have Skills (Top 5) Share Point Administration & Governance 6-9 years administering Share Point environments with strong hands‑on experience in Share Point Online and good understanding of Share Point 2016/2019. Deep knowledge of security, permissions, governance, taxonomy/metadata, and storage management. Power Shell Automation Proven experience using Power Shell for Share Point Online and One Drive administration and bulk operations. Migrations with Sharegate Hands‑on experience planning and executing Share Point, One Drive, and shared drive/file share migrations using Sharegate (assessment, execution, error handling, validation). Microsoft 365 & Entra ID Strong experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (Share Point Online, One Drive, Stream, Viva, Microsoft Search). Experience with Microsoft Entra ID for identity and access management (groups, roles, app access). ITSM & L2/L3 Operations Experience with IT ticketing and agile toolsets (e.g., Service Now, Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence or similar). Strong troubleshooting and root‑cause skills; comfortable working with global, cross‑functional teams and driving issues to closure. Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience with 6-9years of work experience Certifications: Microsoft certifications related to Share Point or Microsoft 365 administration are preferred. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders in a global environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a veteran. title: Senior Payroll & Equity Analyst - US Payroll
jobDescription: Job summary The Senior Payroll and Equity Analyst is responsible for accurate and timely payroll processing, payroll compliance, issue resolution, and payroll-related reporting, with a strong focus on US payroll operations. This role also supports global equity administration activities that flow through payroll, including stock-related transactions, tax setup, reporting, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of US payroll regulations, multi-state payroll requirements, payroll audits, and payroll systems, along with the judgment and discretion needed to handle highly confidential information. This role requires a detail-oriented professional who can work independently, solve operational issues effectively, and collaborate closely with HR, Legal, Tax, Payroll Accounting, and other internal teams. Key Responsibilities Payroll operations Coordinate and support semi-monthly payroll processing with accuracy and timeliness Manage on-cycle and off-cycle payroll activities and monitor outstanding payroll errors daily Review payroll data, validate inputs, and conduct audits of payroll registers to ensure accuracy Conduct quarterly audits of employee taxable wages and help resolve discrepancies Review and resolve payroll issues, discrepancies, and employee questions in a timely manner Process payroll-related transactions including overtime, garnishments, wage assessments, child support orders, spousal support orders, and tax levies Prepare and provide payroll data, reports, and ad hoc analysis to internal stakeholders as needed Support remittances for third-party deductions, withholding taxes, and employer payroll taxes in line with business processes and regulatory requirements Research and respond to requests for confidential payroll information from external agencies, where applicable Stay current on federal, state, and local payroll regulations that impact payroll processing and compliance Equity administration support Support administration of the global equity program in partnership with relevant internal teams Process payroll impacts of stock proceeds and ensure data is accurately reflected in payroll and stock management systems Set up and maintain required tax and profile information for equity-eligible employees Prepare and process equity transactions including new awards, vestings, and releases Support monthly and quarterly stock-related reporting Assist with the annual grant process and annual global vesting cycles for RSUs and PSUs Partner with Legal, HR, Payroll Accounting, and Tax on compliance, reporting, and employee communication related to equity administration Collaboration and continuous improvement Partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders to address payroll and equity-related questions Participate in training and ongoing process improvement initiatives Support special projects and other related responsibilities as assigned Maintain high standards of confidentiality, accuracy, and service orientation Required qualifications 8+ years of recent payroll processing experience in a professional corporate environment Strong hands-on knowledge of US payroll operations and payroll compliance Experience supporting large employee populations, including exempt and non-exempt employees Experience with multi-state payroll processing and withholdings Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with discretion Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and effectively under pressure, while also collaborating well within a team Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word Preferred qualifications Experience with ADP Vantage, ADP Payforce, or similar enterprise payroll systems Experience supporting equity-related payroll processes, including RSUs and PSUs Familiarity with Workday or other HRIS platforms Knowledge of Canada payroll processing Scope and impact This role is an individual contributor position with responsibility for critical payroll execution and support activities. Accuracy, sound judgment, and timely issue resolution are essential, as errors may affect employee pay, compliance, and downstream reporting. The role is expected to handle routine and moderately complex issues independently and escalate more complex matters appropriately. Our team members’ backgrounds, experiences and perspectives add to us as a whole and make us unique. We are proudly an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
